description: 018 Fase 2 US2 — capability for detached workspace windows (label `detached-*`). Same core IPC/event access as Main so the detached webview can invoke layout/lease/pty commands and receive the typed event bus. BYOK is enforced SEPARATELY in lib.rs (`window_byok::check_window_command`): credential commands are denied off-Main regardless of this capability — a 2nd webview is not a 2nd vault (F-I).
